hints.title: Pipeline Continuous Hand-off
hints.text: Every potion must transition between sequential workers without any idle delays, which forces each potion schedule to align with worker availability.

hints.title: Consecutive Potion Offset
hints.text: Determine the earliest possible start time of each potion such that no worker is required to brew two potions simultaneously.

hints.title: Backward Worker Propagation
hints.text: For each potion, walk backward across workers to propagate completion times and identify the bottleneck handover delay.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Processes each potion with a backward pass across workers in constant auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all schedule offsets independently results in excessive time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running state variables avoid allocating 2D schedule matrices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the no-idle flow-shop scheduling pattern and propagate boundary constraints linearly.
